title: RWP IDEA Schema
description: JSON Schema for Rhumb Workflow Protocol (RWP) IDEA artifacts. IDEA is the universal capture artifact in RWP: every thought, feature request, bug report, architectural concept, or strategic initiative starts as an IDEA and progresses through the 7-state lifecycle (captured, refining, ready, approved, promoted, parked, discarded). Path selection happens at approved-time via the `pipeline` field, choosing among architecture (IDEA->AVD->ACS->MP), direct (IDEA->MP), or one_off (IDEA->execution). Per KD-38.6, lifecycle metadata fields are sparse: declared optional in this schema and conditionally required per state by the prose lifecycle spec (idea-lifecycle.spec.md) plus rhumb-validate Level-3 checks. Per KD-38.2, frontmatter is the source of truth on conflict with file location.

id.description: IDEA identifier in the form IDEA-NNNN (4-digit zero-padded). Must match the sequences.yaml authority for the implementation. Future extension to 5+ digits is a separate pattern revision.

type.description: Artifact type discriminator. Always the literal string "idea" for this schema.

status.description: Lifecycle state per the 7-state enum (KD-38.6). Frontmatter is authoritative on conflict with file location (KD-38.2).

classification.description: Access classification. Public IDEAs are shareable artifacts; confidential IDEAs are restricted by the implementing organization.

created.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the IDEA was first captured. Immutable after capture.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent meaningful edit. Bump on every state transition or content change.

authors.description: Authors of the IDEA. Supports human + AI collaboration; minimum one entry. Suggested role values include architect, engineer, pm, assistant, reviewer, other; role is a free string to allow organization-specific values per KD-38.7 anti-over-prescription.

role.description: Author role. Suggested values: architect, engineer, pm, assistant, reviewer, other. Free string to permit organization-specific roles.

tags.description: Optional domain tags for indexing and search.

parent.description: Optional upstream artifact reference. Typically IDEA-NNNN or REQ-NNNNN; free string to permit implementation-specific upstream IDs. null when the IDEA is freestanding.

children.description: Optional downstream artifact references populated as the IDEA progresses (e.g., AVD-NNNN, MP-NNNN). Free strings to permit implementation-specific downstream IDs.

pipeline.description: Path-selection field decided at approved-time (KD-38.5). Values: architecture (IDEA->AVD->ACS->MP rigor path), direct (IDEA->MP fast path for directly-plannable work), one_off (IDEA->execution single-shot work). null means not yet routed. Default-to-architecture-when-ambiguous is the recommended posture.

approved_by.description: Approver name or handle. Populated when status transitions to approved. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of approval. Populated when status transitions to approved. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

approval_policy.description: Approval policy used (e.g., "solo" or "review"). Implementation-specific. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

promoted_to.description: Downstream artifact identifier (e.g., AVD-NNNN or MP-NNNN). Populated when status transitions to promoted. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

promoted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of promotion. Populated when status transitions to promoted. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

promoted_pipeline.description: Pipeline path actually taken at promotion. Same enum as pipeline. Populated when status transitions to promoted. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

parked_as.description: Free-string label for the parked classification (e.g., "roadmap", "backlog", or implementation-specific). Per KD-38.7, the directory layout for parked IDEAs is implementation-specific and not normative; the string value carried here is what matters for state-machine validity.

parked_reason.description: Why the IDEA was parked. Populated when status transitions to parked. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

parked_until.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp until which the IDEA is parked; null means open-ended parking. ISO-8601 only; legacy quarter-shorthand (e.g., 2026-Q3) is not accepted.

discarded_by.description: Discarder name or handle. Populated when status transitions to discarded. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

discarded_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of discard. Populated when status transitions to discarded. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec.

discarded_reason.description: Why the IDEA was discarded. Populated when status transitions to discarded. Optional in schema; required-by-state per the prose lifecycle spec (per KD-38.6, this field is required-when-discarded by the validator, not by JSON Schema's required[] which cannot conditionally require).
